The biggest bar at the low is often the END 🎯

When price sweeps equal lows, the stops underneath become market sells, so volume and negative delta explode. That alone doesn't mean sellers are winning. On the sweep bar the footprint printed 4,800 contracts, stacked sell imbalances and delta -2,100, but the bar closed back above 24,390: passive buyers absorbed the selling. The next bar showed initiative buyers lifting the ask at 3x the bid one tick below, three prices in a row. A real breakdown looks different: value builds below the lows and delta stays negative.

1️⃣ Equal lows = sell stops waiting to become market orders
2️⃣ Record volume + heavy negative delta + close back above = climax and absorption
3️⃣ Enter on the reclaim with stacked buy imbalances and positive delta
4️⃣ Acceptance below the lows = breakdown, no long
